svg.aria-label: Line chart: effect of a plus zero to plus three bonus on success chance for 2d6 versus d20. The 2d6 line rises steeply from 41.7 to 83.3 percent; the d20 line rises gently from 40 to 55 percent.
svg.title: Effect of Attrbute Bonuses: 2D6 vs. D20
svg.desc: Both systems start near 40 percent success. Each plus one is worth a flat 5 points on d20 but 11 to 17 points on 2d6 through the middle of its curve.
